title: AUX Reference Architecture and Full-Ship Integration Sweep
referenceBuildRule: One contemporary Main, one Reactor, STL, FTL, Computer, Sensor, Shield, mainline Armor, deliberate tactical AUX role, and residual mission/support fill to exact Installation Space capacity.
ecmEccmDoctrine: Retain accepted current numerics; CP138 revalidates integration balance and TP opportunity cost only.
shieldAuxDoctrine: Execute only existing Shield Hardener; legacy Shield Battery/Booster numeric seeds are rejected for direct carry-forward and Particle Screen/Field Stabilizer are deferred specialist designs.
powerAuxDoctrine: Audit/reference-map power supply/storage AUX but do not execute them in primary combat lanes before Reactor demand calibration.
